threats.threat_description: An attacker captures RF challenge-response messages and replays them to the vehicle to impersonate the legitimate key fob and gain unauthorized access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity and Confidentiality of RF Challenge-Response Messages and Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and theft.

threats.threat_description: Physical or firmware tampering of the key fob to extract cryptographic keys or manipulate challenge-response behavior to bypass authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry, starting, and compromise of cryptographic secrets.

threats.threat_description: Leakage of key fob secret keys or authentication nonces through side-channel attacks or intercepted RF communications.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material and Challenge-Response Nonces against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, or tracking.

threats.threat_description: An attacker transmits false LF proximity signals to the LF antenna to trigger unauthorized wake-up of the vehicle and initiate authentication flows without the key fob present.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of LF Proximity Signal against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized initiation of vehicle authentication flows.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or interferes with the LF antenna frequency band to prevent detection of the key fob’s presence, blocking legitimate vehicle unlocking or starting.
Physical tampering or modification of the vehicle RF antenna to alter signal transmission or reception quality, enabling relay attacks or blocking legitimate signals.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity and Availability of the RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or denial of service to legitimate users.

threats.threat_description: An attacker uses antenna spoofing or signal amplification to capture or relay RF communication between the key fob and vehicle, exposing authentication data.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of the RF transceiver firmware or configuration to modify forwarded authentication data, allowing replay or injection of fake responses to the BCM.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Auth Data and RF Transceiver Firmware against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Interface Analysis / Firmware Integrity Verification

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on RF messages at the transceiver or antenna to capture challenge-response data and authentication tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Auth Data and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized access to vehicle authentication and control functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or floods the RF transceiver with noise or malformed packets to disrupt communication with the key fob, preventing authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: An attacker impersonates the BCM on the CAN bus or RF transceiver control interface to send unauthorized commands or manipulate authentication flows.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of CAN Lock/Unlock Messages and BCM to RF Transceiver Control Interface against ATM-T0037: Input Prompt to prevent unauthorized vehicle locking, unlocking, or bypassing of authentication flows.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / CAN Bus / BCM-RF Transceiver Interface
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Interface Message Authentication Validation

threats.threat_description: Modification of BCM firmware or configuration data to bypass authentication logic, accept invalid tokens, or issue unauthorized unlock/start commands.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Firmware and Configuration Data against Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

threats.threat_description: Insufficient logging or secure audit trails in BCM may allow an attacker to deny having issued unauthorized unlock or start commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Accountability, Authenticity, and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message audit trails against ATM-T0034: Bypass Mandatory Access Control to prevent denial of unauthorized access actions and loss of forensic evidence.

threats.threat_description: Sensitive cryptographic material, tokens, or unlock/start command metadata could be leaked from BCM memory or via side channels, exposing keys or authorization data.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Start Authorization Token and BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent unauthorized vehicle starting and manipulation of BCM-controlled functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Memory and Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker floods the BCM with LF wake signals, RF messages, or CAN bus traffic causing resource exhaustion, preventing legitimate authentication and vehicle unlocking.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal and In-Vehicle CAN against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in BCM firmware or its restricted API calls to the HSM could allow an attacker to execute unauthorized cryptographic operations or issue tokens without proper authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of Restricted HSM API and Firmware in BCM against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized cryptographic operations and issuance of security tokens that could compromise secure vehicle functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts, modifies, or blocks the Door Lock/Unlock Command (functional asset F1) sent by the BCM on data flows DF4 or DF11 to the Door ECU, causing unauthorized door locking or unlocking or preventing legitimate commands from being executed.
threats.atm_technique_name: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0030: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation to prevent unauthorized door locking/unlocking or denial of legitimate access, which could enable unauthorized entry or entrap occupants.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle Network (BCM to Door ECU via DF4/DF11)
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Interface Message Integrity Validation

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts, modifies, or blocks the Engine Start Command (functional asset F2) sent by the BCM on data flows DF5 or DF13 to the Start Authorization ECU, enabling unauthorized engine start or blocking legitimate start commands.
threats.atm_technique_name: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Engine Start Command against ATM-T0030: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation to prevent unauthorized engine start or denial of legitimate engine start.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Analysis / Fault Injection

threats.threat_description: An attacker with physical or remote access to the Body Control Module attempts to circumvent built-in code integrity checks by exploiting vulnerabilities in the firmware update mechanism. By disabling signature verification or checksum validation, the attacker installs modified firmware that accepts unauthorized unlock or start commands, effectively bypassing authentication controls.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of Firmware in BCM and BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / Diagnostic and Remote Update Interfaces
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Update Process Validation

threats.threat_description: An attacker with local access to the Body Control Module (BCM) exploits insufficient access controls and data protection to perform a comprehensive dump of volatile memory and local file storage. By leveraging command-line interfaces or debugging tools on the BCM, the attacker extracts stored Start Authorization Tokens and BCM Configuration and Access Policies files. This local data extraction enables the adversary to obtain sensitive cryptographic tokens and configuration data, facilitating unauthorized vehicle start commands and bypassing security policies.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Start Authorization Token and BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and bypass of security policies.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Memory and Storage Access Analysis

threats.threat_description: Manipulation of door ECU firmware or CAN messages to unlock doors without valid authorization tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token and CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized unlocking of doors and unauthorized vehicle access.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Analysis / CAN Message Injection Test

threats.threat_description: Door ECU lacks secure logging of received unlock commands leading to inability to trace unauthorized door unlocks.
An attacker sends malformed or flood CAN messages to the Door ECU causing it to ignore legitimate lock/unlock commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent loss of legitimate door locking and unlocking functionality.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts or modifies the actuator command on data flow DF9 (ECU_DOOR -> DOOR_ACT_1), causing doors to lock or unlock without proper authorization or blocking legitimate commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Door Lock/Unlock Command on data flow DF9 against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized or blocked door locking and unlocking.

threats.threat_description: Physical or logical disruption of the actuator command on DF9 (ECU_DOOR -> DOOR_ACT_1) to prevent doors from locking or unlocking as commanded.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of the DF9 (ECU_DOOR -> DOOR_ACT_1) actuator command against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent vehicle doors from failing to lock or unlock as intended.

threats.threat_description: Modification of Start Authorization ECU firmware or manipulation of received tokens to enable engine start without proper authentication.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token and Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in Start Authorization ECU to bypass token verification and enable engine start unauthorized.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: An attacker floods or jams messages on the powertrain interface to block start authorization commands, preventing engine start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized immobilization of the vehicle.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Fault Injection / Network Traffic Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts or modifies the start enable command on data flow DF10 (ECU_START -> ENGINE_ECU) to allow unauthorized engine start or block valid start commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Engine Start Command on data flow DF10 against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized engine start or denial of service to legitimate users.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or blocks the start enable command on data flow DF10 (ECU_START -> ENGINE_ECU), preventing the engine from starting even with valid authorization.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall ensure the Availability of the Start Enable Command on data flow DF10 against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized vehicle immobilization during valid start attempts.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / Wired Data Flow (DF10: ECU_START -> ENGINE_ECU)

threats.threat_description: An attacker targets the Start Authorization ECU by disabling or corrupting its software update mechanism, preventing the application of critical security patches or restoration of the ECU software to a secure state. As a result, the attacker maintains persistent unauthorized control over the ECU's start enable logic, allowing manipulation of the Engine Start Command on data flow DF10 to either enable unauthorized engine starts or block legitimate start requests indefinitely.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Software Update Mechanism against ATM-T0021: Disable Software Update to prevent persistent unauthorized control over the Engine Start Command and unauthorized engine starts or vehicle immobilization.

threats.threat_description: Because the CAN bus is a broadcast medium, an attacker with physical or internal access can eavesdrop on lock/unlock and start authorization messages, potentially learning sensitive operational data.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of In-Vehicle CAN messages against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized disclosure and misuse of lock/unlock and start authorization data.

threats.threat_description: Injection of malicious CAN messages by an attacker to manipulate door lock/unlock or engine start functions without proper authorization.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of In-Vehicle CAN messages against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized door unlocking or engine starting.

threats.threat_description: Flooding the CAN bus with high volume of messages to disrupt normal communication and prevent legitimate commands from being processed.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of In-Vehicle CAN (broadcast medium) against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent loss or delay of critical vehicle control commands resulting in loss of vehicle control or immobilization.

threats.threat_description: An attacker exploits a vulnerability in the body controller ECU's firmware to gain unauthorized local code execution. With this access, the attacker directly manipulates the ECU's control functions to lock or unlock doors and start the engine without detection, bypassing any network-level message authentication. This local control circumvents communication protections on the CAN bus, leading to unauthorized vehicle access and operation.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of In-Vehicle CAN (broadcast medium) against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry, engine start, and loss of vehicle control.

threats.threat_description: Firmware compromise or physical tampering with the HSM to extract cryptographic keys or bypass cryptographic verification and token generation policies.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of HSM Firmware, Secure Boot Measurements, and Cryptographic Key Material against Modify Isolated Execution Environment to prevent unauthorized extraction or misuse of cryptographic keys, bypass of secure boot, and unauthorized code execution.

threats.threat_description: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in the HSM API or secure enclave to perform unauthorized crypto operations or extract keys.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Restricted HSM API and HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements against Exploit Isolated Execution Environment Vulnerability to prevent unauthorized cryptographic operations, key extraction, and subsequent vehicle compromise.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / API Fuzzing / Code Review

threats.threat_description: Side-channel attacks or physical probing on the HSM to leak cryptographic keys or sensitive token generation data.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0028: Hardware Fault Injection to prevent unauthorized ECU programming, message injection, or vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Insufficient attestation or logging mechanisms in the HSM to prove the legitimacy of cryptographic operations or token generation.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Non-repudiation of HSM Attestation / Measurement Data against ATM-T0023: Modify Isolated Execution Environment to prevent unauthorized cryptographic operations and loss of traceability.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of the crypto engine inside the HSM to produce forged verification results or authorization tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and bypass of authentication mechanisms.

threats.threat_description: An attacker with access to the vehicle's diagnostic interface exploits standard diagnostic protocols to issue unauthorized 'write memory by address' commands to the Crypto Engine. By doing so, the attacker modifies the cryptographic key material stored within the engine, enabling the generation of forged start authorization tokens and compromising secure operations.
threats.atm_technique_name: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol to Temporarily Modify Execution

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0074: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol to Temporarily Modify Execution to prevent unauthorized generation of start authorization tokens and vehicle start.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Diagnostic Command Injection Test

threats.threat_description: An attacker with physical or remote access to the vehicle's diagnostic interface leverages standard diagnostic protocols to perform unauthorized 'download and execute' commands targeting the Crypto Engine. By exploiting these capabilities, the attacker injects malicious firmware updates or code into the Crypto Engine, altering its behavior to expose or manipulate cryptographic operations. This unauthorized code execution compromises the integrity of the cryptographic key material and enables the attacker to generate fraudulent start authorization tokens, undermining vehicle security.
threats.atm_technique_name: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol to Temporarily Modify Execution

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0074: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol to Temporarily Modify Execution to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and bypass of immobilizer functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Command Injection Test

threats.threat_description: Extraction of cryptographic keys and key lifecycle metadata from the key store, compromising all cryptographic protections of the system.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent message forging, unauthorized ECU programming, and decryption of sensitive communications.

threats.threat_description: Modification of key metadata or keys in the key store to enable unauthorized key usage or revoke legitimate keys.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall enforce the Integrity, Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Availability of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0023: Modify Isolated Execution Environment to prevent unauthorized cryptographic operations, denial of service, and exposure of sensitive data.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Secure Storage Integrity Audit

threats.threat_description: An attacker targeting the Cryptographic Key Store may implant malicious firmware that uses a custom, proprietary encryption scheme to exfiltrate cryptographic key material. By avoiding standardized cryptographic protocols, the malware conceals its command and control traffic, making network detection difficult. However, the absence of standard cryptographic protocols in securing communications allows reverse engineers to eventually extract the secret keys embedded within the malware, leading to full compromise of the stored cryptographic keys.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0066: Standard Cryptographic Protocol to prevent unauthorized access and compromise of cryptographic operations, including authentication, secure communication, and anti-theft functions.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or manipulation of the door lock actuator to lock or unlock doors without valid command signals.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Actuator Signal against Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized unlocking or locking of vehicle doors.

threats.threat_description: Physical damage or disruption of actuator signals to prevent doors from locking or unlocking as commanded.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of Actuator Signal between the Door ECU and the actuator against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized access to the vehicle or denial of legitimate entry.

threats.threat_description: Manipulation of engine ECU or inverter firmware or commands to enable engine start without valid authorization tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Analysis / Interface Fuzzing

threats.threat_description: Blocking or jamming start commands on the powertrain interface to prevent engine start even with valid authorization.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall ensure the Availability of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized prevention of engine start with valid authorization.

threats.threat_description: An attacker gains access to the Engine ECU / Inverter by exploiting standard diagnostic protocols, such as UDS, to send unauthorized diagnostic commands. By leveraging the write memory by address function, the adversary modifies the ECU firmware to bypass authorization checks and issue engine start commands without valid tokens, effectively enabling unauthorized vehicle ignition through the Powertrain Start Interface.
threats.atm_technique_name: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0067: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol for Affecting Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized vehicle ignition and operation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects false LF wake/proximity events at the LF receiver to trigger unauthorized RF challenge emissions by the BCM.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized initiation of keyless entry/start authentication cycles.

threats.threat_description: Disruption or jamming of LF signals to prevent legitimate wake events from reaching the BCM, blocking key fob detection and authentication.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of the LF Proximity Signal and LF Receiver to BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized blocking of key fob detection and vehicle access.

threats.threat_description: An attacker gains unauthorized access to the Message Annotations (diagram labels) metadata, revealing detailed security property tags such as timestamps, freshness nonces, and identifiers. This disclosure aids in crafting replay or spoofing attacks by understanding message semantics and security contexts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The In-Vehicle Network Communication System shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Message Annotations (diagram labels) against ATM-T0042: File and Directory Discovery to prevent attackers from leveraging metadata disclosure to craft replay or spoofing attacks.

threats.threat_description: An attacker manipulates the Message Annotations (diagram labels) metadata to cause misinterpretation of message security properties by internal components, potentially leading to acceptance of stale or unauthorized commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Internal Communication System shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Message Annotations (diagram labels) against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent acceptance of stale, replayed, or unauthorized commands by internal components.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Configuration and Metadata Integrity Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or corrupts access to the Message Annotations (diagram labels), causing the system to lose critical metadata needed for message validation and freshness checks, resulting in authentication failures or denial of vehicle entry/start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Authentication System shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Message Annotations (diagram labels) against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent authentication failures resulting in denial of vehicle entry or engine start.

threats.threat_description: An attacker compromises the internal HSM bus communication between the Crypto Engine and Cryptographic Key Store, modifying or injecting messages to cause unauthorized key usage, denial of cryptographic operations, or invalid token generation.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM Internal Bus shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of communications between the Crypto Engine and Cryptographic Key Store against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized key usage, denial of cryptographic operations, or invalid authentication token generation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on the internal HSM bus communication between Crypto Engine and Key Store, extracting cryptographic key material or key metadata despite non-exportable key protections, compromising system security.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM Internal Bus shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Key Access data against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized extraction of cryptographic key material and subsequent compromise of ECU security functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or disrupts the internal HSM bus communication between Crypto Engine and Key Store, preventing cryptographic operations such as challenge verification or token generation, causing denial of vehicle entry or start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Hardware Security Module shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of HSM Internal Bus communications between the Crypto Engine and Key Store against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent immobilization of the vehicle and denial of access to authorized users.

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on the RF receive metadata (RSSI, timestamp) produced by the RF front-end, gaining information about signal characteristics and timing that can be used to facilitate relay attacks or location tracking of the keyless entry system.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Keyless Entry System RF Front-End shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF receive metadata (RSSI/timestamp) against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized relay attacks and location tracking of the vehicle or key fob.

threats.threat_description: An attacker manipulates the RF receive metadata (RSSI, timestamp) before it is consumed by BCM or HSM, causing incorrect signal assessment that may allow relay or spoofing attacks to succeed undetected.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Signal Processing Path shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of RF receive metadata (RSSI/timestamp) against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, engine start, or bypass of anti-relay and anti-spoofing mechanisms.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or corrupts the RF receive metadata (RSSI, timestamp) flow, preventing the BCM or HSM from accurately assessing received signals, leading to failed authentications or denial of service.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) and Hardware Security Module (HSM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of RF receive metadata (RSSI/timestamp) against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent failed authentications and denial of service for vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: On the data flow DF1 (ANT_1 -> EXT_1), an attacker injects or spoofs false LF proximity trigger signals, causing the key fob to respond and the vehicle to initiate authentication flows without the legitimate key fob being present.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna and External Receiver shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of LF Proximity Trigger Signals on the ANT_1 to EXT_1 data flow against ATM-T0044: Network Service Scanning to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or starting in the absence of the legitimate key fob.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the LF proximity trigger signal on data flow DF1 (ANT_1 -> EXT_1), preventing the key fob from detecting vehicle proximity and causing authentication failure or denial of access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Passive Entry System shall ensure the Availability of the LF Proximity Trigger Signal on data flow ANT_1 to EXT_1 against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of vehicle access for authorized users.

threats.threat_description: On data flow DF2 (RF_1 -> EXT_1), an attacker spoofs or modifies RF challenge messages sent to the key fob, causing it to receive invalid or manipulated challenges, which may result in authentication failure or unauthorized access attempts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Communication Interface shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of RF challenge messages on data flow DF2 (RF_1 -> EXT_1) against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent authentication failure or unauthorized vehicle access.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or blocks the RF challenge messages on data flow DF2 (RF_1 -> EXT_1), preventing the key fob from receiving challenges and blocking the authentication process.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Communication Module shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of RF challenge messages on data flow RF_1 to EXT_1 against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts and spoofs the RF response message from the key fob on data flow DF3 (EXT_1 -> RF_1), injecting fake or replayed authentication responses to mislead the vehicle authentication process.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Communication Module shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of Auth Data on data flow EXT_1 -> RF_1 against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or blocks the RF response message on data flow DF3 (EXT_1 -> RF_1), preventing authentication data from reaching the vehicle and causing denial of service in keyless entry.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Keyless Entry System shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of the RF Authentication Data on data flow EXT_1 -> RF_1 against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: On data flow DF6 (RF_1 -> BCM_1), an attacker compromises the RF transceiver to modify, replay, or block forwarded authentication data, causing the BCM to accept unauthorized key fob responses or fail authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF transceiver and Body Control Module shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of authentication data on data flow DF6 (RF_1 -> BCM_1) against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or denial of legitimate operation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the Auth Data flow on DF6 (RF_1 -> BCM_1), preventing the BCM from receiving valid key fob responses and causing denial of service in keyless entry operations.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Keyless Entry System shall enforce the Availability of the Auth Data flow between RF_1 and BCM_1 against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle via keyless entry.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts, modifies, or blocks the restricted API calls on data flow DF7 (BCM_1 -> HSM_1), manipulating cryptographic verification requests or causing denial of cryptographic services.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM_1) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of cryptographic verification requests on data flow DF7 between BCM_1 and HSM_1 against ATM-T0033: Bypass UDS Security Access to prevent unauthorized command injection or denial of cryptographic services that could disrupt secure vehicle operations.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Interface Fuzzing / Penetration Testing / Protocol Analysis

threats.threat_description: Blocking or disruption of the restricted API calls on DF7 (BCM_1 -> HSM_1) prevents the HSM from performing necessary cryptographic verification and token generation, causing authentication failures.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The BCM_1 to HSM_1 communication interface shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of restricted API calls against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent authentication failures that could result in user lockout or inability to start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts or modifies the cryptographic result or authorization token on data flow DF8 (HSM_1 -> BCM_1), causing the BCM to accept invalid tokens or reject valid ones.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM_1 and BCM_1 shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token on data flow DF8 against ATM-T0033: Bypass UDS Security Access to prevent unauthorized vehicle start or denial of legitimate start authorization.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the cryptographic result or token flow on DF8 (HSM_1 -> BCM_1), preventing the BCM from receiving authorization to unlock or start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM_1 to BCM_1 communication interface shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of cryptographic authorization tokens against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being unable to unlock or start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on the cryptographic result or authorization token flow on DF8 (HSM_1 -> BCM_1), capturing sensitive token data that could be replayed or analyzed to bypass authentication or authorization controls.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM_1 to BCM_1 communication channel shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of the Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle starting or privileged operations.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts or modifies the HSM attestation or measurement reports on data flow DF18 (HSM_1 -> BCM_1), causing the BCM to accept forged attestation data and undermining trust in HSM integrity assurances.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The BCM_1 shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of HSM Attestation and Measurement Data against ATM-T0033: Bypass UDS Security Access to prevent acceptance of forged integrity assurances and unauthorized escalation of privileges.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or disrupts the HSM attestation or measurement data flow on DF18 (HSM_1 -> BCM_1), preventing the BCM from verifying HSM integrity and causing denial of trusted cryptographic operations.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The communication interface between HSM_1 and BCM_1 shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of attestation and measurement data against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of trusted cryptographic operations.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts or modifies the transmit control messages on data flow DF14 (BCM_1 -> RF_1), causing unauthorized challenges to be sent or blocking valid challenge transmissions.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The BCM_1 and RF_1 shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of control messages on data flow DF14 against ATM-T0033: Bypass UDS Security Access to prevent unauthorized vehicle operations or denial of authorized functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Protocol Fuzzing / Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the transmit control flow DF14 (BCM_1 -> RF_1), preventing the RF transceiver from sending challenges and blocking the authentication process.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The BCM_1 -> RF_1 communication interface shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of the DF14 control flow against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of keyless entry and start functionality for the user.

threats.threat_description: An attacker physically tampers with or modifies the analog RF waveform on data flow DF15 (RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1), enabling relay, spoofing, or signal amplification attacks that bypass vehicle proximity checks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1 against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the analog RF waveform on data flow DF15 (RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1), preventing challenge or response signals from reaching the vehicle exterior and causing denial of wireless communication.

An attacker manipulates or blocks the received RF waveform on data flow DF16 (ANT_RF_1 -> RF_1), causing the RF transceiver to demodulate incorrect or no response frames, resulting in authentication errors or denial of service.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of RF Communication on the ANT_RF_1 to RF_1 data flow against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent authentication errors or denial of service for legitimate key fob operations.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Fault Injection / RF Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects false or replayed LF wake/proximity events on data flow DF17 (LF_RX_1 -> BCM_1), causing the BCM to initiate authentication flows without the legitimate key fob being present.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver to BCM Event/Control Link shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of LF wake/proximity events against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized initiation of authentication and vehicle unlocking.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams LF wake/proximity events on data flow DF17 (LF_RX_1 -> BCM_1), preventing the BCM from detecting key fob proximity and causing authentication failure or denial of service.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF wake/proximity signal data flow (LF_RX_1 -> BCM_1) against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized denial of keyless vehicle access and starting for legitimate users.
